clips.title: The story
paras: A concerned alchemist asks travelers to track down her missing husband, Ardin Grassman, who vanished after pursuing rumors of towering, unknown grasses. Ardin's botanical curiosity led him straight toward a nearby excavation site, where dangerous wildlife and spider attacks have besieged the crew.

In 'Lost in the Thicket Things', an alchemist seeks help tracking down her missing husband, Ardin Grassman. Ardin possesses an uncanny, instinctual affinity for nature, routinely braving steep cliffs and distant wilderness to gather rare herbs and botanical specimens to stock her alchemy supplies. When a passing excavation crew brought word of bizarre, towering grasses unlike anything seen before, Ardin's curiosity got the better of him, and he set out to inspect the flora for himself.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My husband, Ardin, has a rare gift for sensing nature. He'll scale any peak to gather the herbs and flowers I need for my alchemy, keeping our shelves and pantry stocked.

But I fear he's wandered into trouble. An excavation crew passed through seeking supplies. They spoke, among other things, of towering grasses unlike anything they'd ever seen. Those were what he told me he had to go see for himself. He's been gone too long!
If you learn anything of him, I'd be grateful.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I thought we were done for! Something upset the wildlife around here and our excavation team was overwhelmed. Thank you for helping us with those spiders.
